section_summary.extract_value: This section reports a single study (not labeled as 'Study 1') that developed and validated a Brazilian adaptation of the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) for young adolescents. Participants were 347 Brazilian adolescents (171 male, 176 female) aged 10–13 years; the BAS showed acceptable internal consistency and a one-factor structure, and BAS scores correlated with BMI (r = –.230, p < .001).
